xna-type.name: LocalNetworkGamer
xna-type.summary: Represents a local player in a network session.

property.name: IsDataAvailable
property.summary: Determines if there is incoming packet data for this player.

property.name: SignedInGamer
property.summary: Gets the SignedInGamer instance for this SignedInGamer object.

method.name: EnableSendVoice
method.summary: Specifies whether voice data should be sent to, or received from, the specified remote gamer.

overload.summary: Specifies whether voice data should be sent to, or received from, the specified remote gamer.

parameters.parameter: A remote gamer in the session.
true if voice is enabled; false otherwise.

overload.remarks: Call this method for local gamer instances only. By default, voice is enabled for all gamers. However, you can selectively turn it off to enable features such as team chat. Also, you can dynamically turn it on or off, depending on the player's location in the game world, to achieve a proximity voice effect.

method.name: ReceiveData
method.summary: Reads the next incoming packet using the specified values.

overload.summary: Reads the next incoming packet using the specified values.

parameters.parameter: Storage for the network packet data.
Offset, in bytes, to begin reading data.
[ OutAttribute ] Gamer who sent this packet.

overload.returns: Number of bytes read from the network packet. Returns 0 if no packet is available.
overload.remarks: ReceiveData copies the packet data into the array specified by data , returning the number of bytes read. If several independent packets are available, only one is returned for each ReceiveData call.

overload.summary: Reads the next incoming packet and copies the packet data into the specified reader object.

parameters.parameter: Network packet data.
[ OutAttribute ] Gamer who sent this packet.

overload.returns: Number of bytes read from the network packet. Returns 0 if no packet is available.
overload.remarks: If several independent packets are available, only one will be returned on each call to ReceiveData .

overload.summary: Reads the next incoming packet using the specified values.

parameters.parameter: Storage for the network packet data.
[ OutAttribute ] Gamer who sent this packet.

overload.returns: Number of bytes read from the network packet. Returns 0 if no packet is available.
overload.remarks: ReceiveData copies the packet data into the array specified by data , returning the number of bytes read. If several independent packets are available, only one is returned for each ReceiveData call.

method.name: SendData
method.summary: Sends a byte array to all gamers in a session. This includes the gamer sending the packet.

overload.summary: Sends a byte array to all gamers in a session. This includes the gamer sending the packet.

parameters.parameter: Byte array containing session data.
Enumeration containing data send options.

overload.summary: Sends a byte array to the specified gamer.

parameters.parameter: Byte array containing session data.
Enumeration containing data send options.
Gamer to receive the data packet.

overload.summary: Sends a network packet to the specified gamer in a session.

parameters.parameter: Byte array containing session data.
Enumeration containing data send options.
Gamer receiving the data.

overload.summary: Sends a selected portion of a byte array to the specified gamer.
overload.syntax: public void SendData ( byte[] data, int offset, int count, SendDataOptions options, NetworkGamer recipient )

parameters.parameter: Byte array containing session data.
Offset, in bytes, to the start of the data.
Amount, in bytes, of data sent.
Enumeration containing data send options.
Gamer to receive the data packet.

overload.summary: Sends a selected portion of a byte array to all gamers in a session. This includes the gamer sending the packet.

parameters.parameter: Byte array containing session data.
Offset, in bytes, to the start of the data.
Amount, in bytes, of data sent.
Enumeration containing data send options.

overload.summary: Sends a network packet to all gamers in a session. This includes the gamer sending the packet.

parameters.parameter: Byte array containing session data.
Enumeration containing data send options.

method.name: SendPartyInvites
method.summary: Sends game invitations to all party members that are not in the current game session.

overload.summary: Sends game invitations to all party members that are not in the current game session.
overload.remarks: This method has no effect when the player is not currently a member of a LIVE party, or on platforms that do not support LIVE parties.
